title: Geometry of the subgaussian body of an isotropic convex body
summary: For a centered convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$, let $Ψ_2(K)$ denote the symmetric convex body whose support function is given by the $ψ_2$-norms of linear functionals on $K$. The recent solution of Milman's problem on the existence of subgaussian directions by Letwin and Mikulincer naturally motivates the study of the geometry of this body. We prove that $Ψ_2(K)$ has bounded volume ratio with respect to the $L_2$-centroid body $Z_2(K)$.
